::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
TI Bengaluru is one of the longest-running semiconductor design centres in India, operational since 1985. It is a full chip design centre, not just a support office. TI opened a 550,000 sq ft product R&D centre in Bengaluru, inaugurated by Ashwini Vaishnaw, marking 40 years in India (2026-02-07).
:::

## What does this firm design?

Analog and mixed-signal ICs, power management chips, embedded microcontrollers (MSP430, C2000 series), and industrial interface chips. Bengaluru handles complete chip ownership from concept to production.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 4/5:** Analog, mixed-signal and power ICs: hard but on mature nodes.
- **Strategic depth 5/5:** First MNC R&D centre in India (1985); Bengaluru product teams own analog and embedded product development.
- **Design completeness 5/5:** New centre houses product design teams, IC design labs and an end-to-end reliability lab.
- **India scale 4/5:** Company says 'thousands' of India employees; 5,000 figure not independently confirmed.
